note: Draft of the rights the neptune provider needs, for the Runtime's provider lockdown. Not read by Runtime v2.0.1 (its manifest refuses unknown fields); to move into the provider manifest's rights field once its format is set.

connect.why: JSON-RPC of the local, outbound-only neptune-core node (port from the Home's provider config; loopback IP literals only, no DNS)

connect.when: only after the user approves USD prices in Home, and only when the Home's config sets price_sources

connect.why: a second source for the same prices

network.development_only: scripts/dev-home.sh points neptune-main at a public node over https (allow_remote_nodes); a locked-down provider gets loopback only.

exec.location: next to the provider binary, in the same signed bundle
exec.why: Triton VM proving runs out of process (neptune-core's prover job queue); regtest uses mock proofs and execs nothing

files.why: per-network wallet state, the seed phrase and open swap secrets (owner-only 0600 files), the swap journal

memory: real proving needs several GB in the prover process
